The long lecture covered polysemy.

meaning_en: the state of being protected from danger or harm
example_en: Employee safety is our top priority at work.
examples_extra: The airline puts passenger safety above everything else.
We ran to the safety of the nearest building.

meaning_en: Happening in a series; repeated many times.
example_en: A serial killer commits multiple murders over time.
examples_extra: The story was published in serial form.
He is a serial entrepreneur.

meaning_en: The way something is organized or arranged.
example_en: The new office setup improved productivity.
examples_extra: The setup took an hour.
She changed the room setup.

meaning_en: A dark area produced when light is blocked.
example_en: The tree cast a long shadow on the grass.
examples_extra: The tree casts a long shadow.
He hid in the shadows.

meaning_en: The main subject or idea in a work.
example_en: The theme of the novel is love and loss.
examples_extra: The theme of the book is love.
This year's theme is the environment.

meaning_en: To turn something upside down.
example_en: He upended the box to empty its contents.
examples_extra: The storm upended the boat.
The news upended our plans.
